title: fix(runtime): MCP run_action answers a declared action with no handler as /actions does, 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XSaaQXQ6J3byqVhvgRU927w)_

domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pVLKxR5eAhTYetnwR

Fixes #31330

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一个声明了但没有 handler 的动作（"ghost" 动作），MCP bridge 以前抛一个不带 code 的 `Error('No handler registered …')`。现在改为抛出 `/api/v1/actions` 自己回答的那个路由未命中：同一句 `Action 'X' on object 'Y' not found`，`404`，`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`。
- 为什么改：自 #31271 起，`run_action` 通过 `/actions` 的同一个 reader（`actionsDoorAnswerOf`）作答，不带 code 的抛错被当成 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`，等于告诉 agent 它的输入有错。而 REST 对同一个动作回 `404`。
- 风险与回滚：只改 runtime 里一处抛错（`action-execution.ts`）。只有 MCP 的 bridge 能走到这里，REST 及其它门的回答不变（runtime 全量绿，`/actions` 的 pin 都没改）。MCP 为这个未命中写的 `action_invocation` 行也随之变成 `404` / `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`，与 REST 写的那行一致。回滚即 revert。patch。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 中 `!dispatch.dispatched` 那段；新测试 `packages/runtime/src/mcp-run-action-ghost-routing-miss.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/mcp-run-action-ghost-routing-miss.test.ts`，预期 6 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，由席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/runtime` `action-execution.ts`.** When the MCP bridge (`invokeBusinessAction` → `dispatchAdmittedBusinessAction`) finds no handler for a declared script action, it now throws the routing miss as REST `/actions` answers it from its routing-miss branch (`domains/actions.ts`). The sentence is `Action 'X' on object 'Y' not found`, the status is `404`, and the code is `standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus(404)`, which is `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. It used to throw `Error('No handler registered for action 'X' on 'Y'')` with no code.
- **Sentence.** The order said to keep the producer's sentence unless `/actions` serves a different one. `/actions` does serve a different one, so the throw now uses the door's sentence, and the two doors answer the same bytes. No code reads the old sentence; the only readers were three test pins, which move here.

| Ghost action (declared, no handler) | Before (main f4b4c8ae) | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MCP `run_action` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `No handler registered for action 'X' on 'Y'` | `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `Action 'X' on object 'Y' not found` |
| MCP `action_invocation` row | `failed`, `500`, `INTERNAL_ERROR` | `failed`, `404`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| REST `POST /api/v1/actions` (the measured target) | `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, same sentence | unchanged |
| CONTROL: action with a handler | runs on both doors | unchanged |
| CONTROL: handler's coded refusal `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 | code and status kept on both doors | unchanged |

## Tests

- New `packages/runtime/src/mcp-run-action-ghost-routing-miss.test.ts`, 6 rows. One kernel serves both doors (`handleActions` and `buildMcpBridge().runAction`), so each pin is the agreement between them:
  - REST answers `404` / `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` / the routed-object sentence (the measured target).
  - The bridge's throw has the same code, status and sentence as the REST body.
  - `actionsDoorAnswerOf(thrown)` equals the REST body (code, status, message, no `declaredCode`).
  - Each door writes one `failed` invocation row with `404` / `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.
  - CONTROL: with a handler bound, the action runs on both doors.
  - CONTROL: a handler's coded refusal keeps its code and status on both doors.
- `mcp-list-actions-handler-probe.test.ts`: the two `rejects.toThrow(/No handler registered/)` pins now assert `{ code: 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND', status: 404 }`.
- `packages/cli/test/package-install-local-handlers.integration.test.ts`: the ghost `run_action` pin moves from `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 to the exact envelope `{ code: 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND', status: 404, message: "Action 'ghost_task' on object 'tasks_app_task' not found" }`, measured over a real `os start` stack.
- `resume_run` is not pinned: it continues a paused run through `automation.resume` and never reaches the script dispatch, so it cannot hit the miss.

## Acceptance notes

- **Who reads the throw.** Only `domains/mcp.ts`'s bridge `runAction` calls `invokeBusinessAction`; REST `/actions` answers its own miss before any throw. No REST or other door's answer moves. `service-settings`' own "No handler registered … in 'ns'" sentence is a different producer and is unchanged.
- **Past-tense comments left as they are.** `domains/mcp.ts` (~961), `app-artifact-handlers.ts` (~25) and `cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (~5673) mention the old sentence as a measured history ("was listed … and refused there with …"). They are still true as history, and two of the files are outside this claim's surface.
- **Clause-②: no.** A ghost action's `run_action` answer moves from an uncoded 400 to the coded miss `/actions` already serves. No new export, type or protocol member.

## Verification

All on head `f841c43e` (base `f4b4c8ae`).

<details><summary>Red first, fix, suites</summary>

- Red first on base `f4b4c8ae`, the new runtime file: Tests 3 failed | 3 passed (6). The bridge threw `code: undefined`, `status: undefined`; `actionsDoorAnswerOf` gave `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400; the MCP row recorded `500` / `INTERNAL_ERROR`. The REST pin and both CONTROLs were green.
- With the fix: the new file and the probe file, Tests 12 passed (12). The runtime suite and the cli file below ran on `ce565b30`; `f841c43e` changes only those two runtime test files (a module-top import, one unused fake member), and both were rerun green on it.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 556 passed (556), Tests 8963 passed | 19 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `packages/cli/test/package-install-local-handlers.integration.test.ts` (after `--filter '@objectstack/cli...' build`): Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 17 passed (17); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `typecheck` for `@objectstack/runtime` (on `f841c43e`) and `@objectstack/cli`: exit 0 (test layers held: runtime 27 / 186 / 66, cli 3 / 28 / 6).
- Lint, as the root script runs it, scoped to the touched packages (`eslint packages/runtime/src packages/cli/test --no-inline-config`): exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (ablation-replace, restored to HEAD)</summary>

- `action-execution.ts`: the `code` / `status` on the miss throw spread only under a condition that is never true (`String('ABL').length < 0`), so the throw goes back to uncoded. Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob bcee193c06b8 to eb08314860a9). The new file plus the probe file: Tests 5 failed | 7 passed (12). The 3 new parity rows and the 2 probe rows went red; the REST pin and the CONTROLs stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD (bcee193c06b8), `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `f841c43e`: 67 commands, each run with stdin from `/dev/null`, all exit 0. The first loop, on `ce565b30`, read two reds from the new test file, both fixed in `f841c43e`: `check:engine-double-contract` (an unused `findOne` on the engine fake, now dropped) and `check:test-source-alias` (the new file and the edited probe file now pay the `@objectstack/metadata` load at module top). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 on that first loop (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) and 0 on the full rerun. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 67 derived families accounted for, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Not run locally (CI): `test:repo`, dogfood shards, type-check lanes, the rest of the cli integration tier.

</details>
